reviewer.independence: The lead did not author the four current-pass candidate packets. Prior drafts and measurements were visible, so this is not blinded.

purpose: Consolidate the current funnel-expansion packets into an exact human editorial decision aid. This review is not human approval, publication authorization, scheduling authorization, or deployment authorization.

candidates.title: The app that went dark
candidates.evidence: Finish-pass v4 public-by packet; 3,023 observations, 25/25 usable windows, no full-window overlaps, tie groups retained.
candidates.requiredDecision: Accept conservative AP/CNN public-by timing semantics, exact wording/source roles, five-card identity, content/runtime hash, and proposed 2026-09-08T05:00:00Z release.

candidates.title: Stop the three-peat
candidates.evidence: Finish-pass v2 archived-page packet; 5,167 observations, 25/25 usable windows, no full-window overlaps, strict five-way ordering.
candidates.requiredDecision: Accept conservative archived-page public-by bounds, the combined Hurts card, exact five-card order/content/runtime hash, and proposed 2026-09-09T05:00:00Z release.

candidates.title: One Battle After Another — Best Picture 2026
candidates.evidence: Current-pass complete packet; 4,168 observations, 25/25 usable windows, 7/10 pairwise agreement, two captured publishers per card.
candidates.implementation: Registered strict editorial-review v2 draft; private DEV preview; no daily entry.
candidates.requiredDecision: Accept conservative source-availability bounds, the Critics Choice/Golden Globes tie boundary, and adjacent-precursor distinctness; then create and approve the immutable v2 runtime identity for 2026-09-10T05:00:00Z.

candidates.title: Bitcoin’s road to $100,000
candidates.evidence: Current-pass five-card packet; 6,609 observations, 25/25 usable windows, 6/8 comparable agreement, exact contract prices only; overlap disclosed.
candidates.implementation: Registered strict five-card editorial-review v2 draft with private DEV preview; the existing v1 is an eight-event study and remains untouched.
candidates.requiredDecision: Review the fullMarketLifetime boundary and three day-level anchors, then approve 2026-09-11T05:00:00Z if desired.

candidates.title: The Canadian comeback
candidates.evidence: Current-pass strict packet; 2,723 observations, 25/25 usable windows, 7 comparable pairs, three rank levels; AP replaces the failed Axios path and unknown-time retrospective evidence is excluded.
candidates.implementation: Registered strict editorial-review v2 draft with packaged public bundle and private DEV preview.
candidates.requiredDecision: Accept the AP replacement, conservative timing, and three-card tie before any 2026-09-12T05:00:00Z release.

candidates.title: The comeback nobody could call
candidates.evidence: Current-pass packet has five usable windows and corrected ABC bound, but assigns no response scores/ranks; source availability and repeated Butler decision remain open.
candidates.implementation: Candidate packet only; no daily entry.
candidates.requiredDecision: Resolve upper-bound timing and primary-capture gaps, decide on repeating Butler after Biden, calculate/independently review the final comparison packet, and use only as the optional buffer.

recommendation.reason: This fills six distinct substantive funnel identities with evidence-backed packets and preserves a seventh candidate buffer. The lower-confidence Trump packet is kept outside the core. No proposal is counted as approved runway.
